newsitem.title: GREECE: BANK OF ATHENS SETS REPEAT SHAREHOLDERS MEETING.
newsitem.headline: BANK OF ATHENS SETS REPEAT SHAREHOLDERS MEETING.

text.p: The Bank of Athens will hold a repeat shareholders meeting on July 11 to present plans for a share capital increase, it said in a statement.
Its president Chul Kim told shareholders at the annual meeting on Friday that the bank's goal is to become profitable this year.

The Bank of Athens, a member of South Korea's Hanwha Group, posted its first consolidated balance sheet and presented the activities of subsidiaries Hanwha Hellas Fund Management and Insurance Brokers. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
